marketing_description: The Trex® Rail Kit (part 543300276) provides an 8 ft composite rail in black with round black aluminum balusters, designed for horizontal installation on decks. Included hardware enables straightforward installation of the single‑piece kit, and the CleanBoost‑treated composite resists stains, mildew, rot and splintering while the recycled material meets eco‑friendly standards. This kit is part of the Trex Select Classic Collection, offering weather‑resistant, UV‑protected performance for commercial projects.
